Name: Agile
Effect: Creatures with Agile have an additional, independent chance to dodge attacks.

Name: Arcane
Effect: When an Arcane creature Casts a spell, the spell does not consume any Charges.

Name: Barrier
Effect: Barrier absorbs a certain amount of damage. After the maximum amount of damage is dealt, the buff is removed. Barrier strength cannot exceed 200% of a creature's highest stat when this buff is applied.

Name: Defensive
Effect: Creatures with Defensive automatically Defend at the end of their turn.

Name: Immune
Effect: Creatures with Immune can't be afflicted with debuffs.

Name: Invisible
Effect: Invisible creatures cannot be manually targeted by enemy attacks or spells. This buff is removed after the creature takes an action.

Name: Leeching
Effect: Creatures with Leeching recover Health equal to 25% of the damage they deal.

Name: Mending
Effect: Creatures with Mending recover 30% Health at the start of their turn.

Name: Proficient
Effect: Proficient creatures gain 30% more benefits from their Artifact's Stat Slots, other than Health.

Name: Protected
Effect: Creatures with Protected take 50% less damage.

Name: Rebirth
Effect: Creatures with Rebirth are resurrected with 50% Health when they die.

Name: Repelling
Effect: Repelling creatures have a 50% chance to ignore damage from spells.

Name: Savage
Effect: Savage creatures have an additional, independent chance to deal critical damage with attacks.

Name: Shelled
Effect: Shelled negates the next incoming attack or spell.

Name: Splashing
Effect: Creatures with Splashing deal 50% of their damage to enemies adjacent to the target they Attack.

Name: Taunting
Effect: Creatures with Taunting automatically Provoke at the end of their turn.

Name: Warded
Effect: Creatures with Warded cannot lose stats.
